headline: MYST stamps its locks per save
lede: Session 6 shipped the original's per-copy combination codes: every fresh island draws its own safe, star and sphere codes from a seed, and every clue — Atrus's note, the dome's true stars, the sphere's singing posts — rides that seed. Same seed, same island; restart and you get a new book of Myst.

notes.text: #1005 (PR #1006): seeded codes in codes.js — safe 3×1-9, star/sphere permutations, ?seed=N pins, restart redraws.
Clues stay honest: the shelf note spells the seeded digits in words, the cave dome grows four stars sized to the seeded ranks, the posts sing the seeded ring order.
README honesty pass (#961 pattern): the stale four-Ages walkability roll-up is CLOSED-marked so idle picks stop re-kicking shipped work; mystcheck 258/0, 25/25 mutants die, mystplay 13/13 live.
All flagship honest gaps are now owned (QA holds #994/#1001, MYST polish filed as #1008) — next free lane must re-run idle.mjs before picking.

look.text: Open MYST — every visit, a different set of locks
